features.label: Integrated pneumatic system
features.text: Built-in air pump and release valve allow for customizable compression to manage swelling.

features.label: Short shell design
features.text: A lower profile shell immobilizes the foot and ankle without extending far up the leg.

features.label: Stable rocker bottom
features.text: The low and wide rocker sole encourages a natural gait and smoother steps.

features.label: Shock absorbing sole
features.text: Cushioned outsole reduces impact at the heel for more comfortable walking.

features.label: Breathable seamless liner
features.text: Soft interior material wicks moisture away to keep the foot cool and dry.
